'''Desark Fey'lya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] and the first secretary of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], after a [[battle over Kothlis]], Fey'lya was approached by a diplomatic delegation of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] noted the importance of the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] to the war effort and asked for [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] to remain loyal to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Fey'lya enthusiastically agreed and thanked the Jedi for chasing away the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces during the battle. However, a [[Padawan/Legends|padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], who was also present during the meeting, sensed through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that Fey'lya was lying and expressed that observation aloud, guessing that Fey'lya probably invited the Separatists in the first place. The Bothan delegation took that as an insult and Fey'lya stated that both Kothlis and the Bothan spynet would remain neutral during the conflict, before leaving along with his delegation.
